relationships.subject: vertebral endplate defects
relationships.evidence_quote: Histologically, Defect group was characterized by upregulation of COX-2, PGE-2, and EP-4 in endplate tissue sections.

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: Multivariate regression analyses reveled that percentage of COX-2-positive cells was associated with endplate defects (OR=1.509, 95%CI [1.048-2.171], p=.027)

key_findings: Endplate defects were associated with higher VAS-Back/ODI and upregulated COX-2/PGE-2/EP-4 in endplate tissue.
VAS-Back correlated moderately with COX-2, PGE-2 and EP-4 expression.
